1: package llmverify
2: 
3: import chisel3._
4: import chisel3.util._
5: import chiselFv._
6: 
7: class ABypassCtrl extends Module with Formal {
8:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
9:     // Clocks & Stalls
10:     val Phi1 = Input(Bool())
11:     val Stall_s1 = Input(Bool())
12:     val IStall_s1 = Input(Bool())
13:     val MemStall_s1 = Input(Bool())
14: 
15:     // Boosting information
16:     val ABoosted_s1e = Input(Bool())
17:     val BBoosted_s1e = Input(Bool())
18:     val ABoostValid_v1e = Input(Bool())
19:     val BBoostValid_v1e = Input(Bool())
20: 
21:     // Instruction WB cancel
22:     val AKill_s1e = Input(Bool())
23:     val AIgnore_s2e = Input(Bool())
24:     val BKill_s1e = Input(Bool())
25:     val BIgnore_s2e = Input(Bool())
26:     val ANoDest_s1e = Input(Bool())
27:     val BNoDest_s1e = Input(Bool())
28:     val ADestIsZero_v1e = Input(Bool())
29:     val BDestIsZero_v1e = Input(Bool())
30: 
31:     val ASBypBmem_s1e = Input(Bool())
32:     val ATBypBmem_s1e = Input(Bool())
33:     val BIsLoad_s1e = Input(Bool())
34: 
35:     // Branches & Exceptions
36:     val Commit_s1e = Input(Bool())
37:     val Squash_s1e = Input(Bool())
38:     val Except_s1w = Input(Bool())
39: 
40:     // Outputs
41:     val Alpha1_s1m = Output(Bool())
42:     val Beta1_s1m = Output(Bool())
43:     val Delta2_q2 = Output(Bool())
44:     val ASBypassLoad_s1e = Output(Bool())
45:     val ASBypassData_s1e = Output(Bool())
46:     val ATBypassLoad_s1e = Output(Bool())
47:     val ATBypassData_s1e = Output(Bool())
48: 
49:     val ABoosted_s2e = Output(Bool())
50:     val ABoosted_s2m = Output(Bool())
51:     val AValid_s1e = Output(Bool())
52:     val AValid_s2e = Output(Bool())
53:     val AValid_s2m = Output(Bool())
54:     val AValid_s1w = Output(Bool())
55:     val BBoosted_s2e = Output(Bool())
56:     val BBoosted_s2m = Output(Bool())
57:     val BValid_s2e = Output(Bool())
58:     val BValid_s2m = Output(Bool())
59:   })
60: 
61:   // Internal signals
62:   val Phi2 = ~io.Phi1
63: 
64:   // Delayed version of Stall
65:   val IStall_s2 = RegInit(false.B)
66:   val MemStall_s2 = RegInit(false.B)
67: 
68:   // Kill Chain registers
69:   val AValid_s2e = RegInit(false.B)
70:   val AValid_s1m = RegInit(false.B)
71:   val AValid_s2m = RegInit(false.B)
72:   val AValid_s1w = RegInit(false.B)
73: 
74:   val BValid_s2e = RegInit(false.B)
75:   val BValid_s1m = RegInit(false.B)
76:   val BValid_s2m = RegInit(false.B)
77: 
78:   val ABoosted_s2e = RegInit(false.B)
79:   val ABoosted_s1m = RegInit(false.B)
80:   val ABoosted_s2m = RegInit(false.B)
81: 
82:   val ABoostValid_s2e = RegInit(false.B)
83:   val ABoostValid_s1m = RegInit(false.B)
84:   val ABoostValid_s2m = RegInit(false.B)
85: 
86:   val BBoostValid_s2e = RegInit(false.B)
87:   val BBoostValid_s1m = RegInit(false.B)
88:   val BBoostValid_s2m = RegInit(false.B)
89: 
90:   val BBoosted_s2e = RegInit(false.B)
91:   val BBoosted_s1m = RegInit(false.B)
92:   val BBoosted_s2m = RegInit(false.B)
93: 
94:   val BIsLoad_s2e = RegInit(false.B)
95:   val BIsLoad_s1m = RegInit(false.B)
96:   val BIsLoad_s2m = RegInit(false.B)
97:   val BIsLoad_s1w = RegInit(false.B)
98: 
99:   // Control Logic
100:   // Qualify the clocks
101:   val Delta2_q2_wire = (~IStall_s2 | MemStall_s2) & Phi2
102:   io.Delta2_q2 := Delta2_q2_wire
103: 
104:   // Bypass control logic
105:   io.ASBypassLoad_s1e := io.ASBypBmem_s1e & BIsLoad_s1w & ~io.AKill_s1e
106:   io.ATBypassLoad_s1e := io.ATBypBmem_s1e & BIsLoad_s1w & ~io.AKill_s1e
107:   io.ASBypassData_s1e := ~(io.ASBypBmem_s1e & BIsLoad_s1w) & ~io.AKill_s1e
108:   io.ATBypassData_s1e := ~(io.ATBypBmem_s1e & BIsLoad_s1w) & ~io.AKill_s1e
109: 
110:   // Delay IStall
111:   when(io.Phi1) {
112:     IStall_s2 := io.IStall_s1
113:     MemStall_s2 := io.MemStall_s1
114:   }
115: 
116:   // Random Logic
117:   io.AValid_s1e := ~(io.AKill_s1e | io.ANoDest_s1e | io.Except_s1w)
118: 
119:   when(io.Phi1 & ~io.Stall_s1) {
120:     AValid_s2e := ~(io.AKill_s1e | io.ANoDest_s1e | io.Except_s1w)
121:     AValid_s2m := AValid_s1m & ~io.Except_s1w
122: 
123:     // Boost logic
124:     ABoosted_s2e := io.ABoosted_s1e ^ (io.Commit_s1e & io.ABoostValid_v1e)
125:     ABoostValid_s2e := io.ABoostValid_v1e & ~(io.Commit_s1e | io.Squash_s1e)
126:     ABoosted_s2m := ABoosted_s2e ^ (io.Commit_s1e & io.ABoostValid_v1e)
127:     ABoostValid_s2m := ABoostValid_s1m & ~(io.Commit_s1e | io.Squash_s1e)
128:   }
129: 
130:   when(Phi2) {
131:     AValid_s1m := AValid_s2e & ~io.AIgnore_s2e
132:     AValid_s1w := AValid_s2m
133:     ABoosted_s1m := ABoosted_s2e
134:     ABoostValid_s1m := ABoostValid_s2e
135:   }
136: 
137:   when(io.Phi1 & ~io.Stall_s1) {
138:     BValid_s2e := ~(io.BKill_s1e | io.BNoDest_s1e | io.Except_s1w)
139:     BValid_s2m := BValid_s1m & ~io.Except_s1w
140: 
141:     // Boost logic for B
142:     BBoosted_s2e := io.BBoosted_s1e ^ (io.Commit_s1e & io.BBoostValid_v1e)
143:     BBoostValid_s2e := io.BBoostValid_v1e & ~(io.Commit_s1e | io.Squash_s1e)
144:     BBoosted_s2m := BBoosted_s2e ^ (io.Commit_s1e & io.BBoostValid_v1e)
145:     BBoostValid_s2m := BBoostValid_s1m & ~(io.Commit_s1e | io.Squash_s1e)
146: 
147:     // Keep track of which B-side instrs are loads
148:     BIsLoad_s2e := io.BIsLoad_s1e
149:     BIsLoad_s2m := BIsLoad_s1m
150:   }
151: 
152:   when(Phi2) {
153:     BValid_s1m := BValid_s2e & ~io.BIgnore_s2e
154:     BBoosted_s1m := BBoosted_s2e
155:     BBoostValid_s1m := BBoostValid_s2e
156:     BIsLoad_s1m := BIsLoad_s2e
157:     BIsLoad_s1w := BIsLoad_s2m
158:   }
159: 
160:   // Don't toggle datapath latches if instruction was killed
161:   io.Alpha1_s1m := AValid_s1m & ~io.Stall_s1
162:   io.Beta1_s1m := BValid_s1m & ~io.Stall_s1
163: 
164:   // Connect outputs
165:   io.ABoosted_s2e := ABoosted_s2e
166:   io.ABoosted_s2m := ABoosted_s2m
167:   io.AValid_s2e := AValid_s2e
168:   io.AValid_s2m := AValid_s2m
169:   io.AValid_s1w := AValid_s1w
170:   io.BBoosted_s2e := BBoosted_s2e
171:   io.BBoosted_s2m := BBoosted_s2m
172:   io.BValid_s2e := BValid_s2e
173:   io.BValid_s2m := BValid_s2m
174: 
175:   // =====================================================================
176:   // FORMAL ASSERTIONS
177:   // =====================================================================
178: 
179:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
180:   // SAFETY 1: Load bypass and data bypass are mutually exclusive
181:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
182:   // The bypass control logic ensures ASBypassLoad_s1e and ASBypassData_s1e
183:   // are complementary when AKill_s1e is low. Verify they are never both true.
184:   fvAssert(!(io.ASBypassLoad_s1e && io.ASBypassData_s1e),
185:            "ASBypassLoad_Data_mutex")
186:   fvAssert(!(io.ATBypassLoad_s1e && io.ATBypassData_s1e),
187:            "ATBypassLoad_Data_mutex")
188: 
189:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
190:   // SAFETY 2: Load bypass implies the B-side instruction is tracked as a load
191:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
192:   fvAssert(!io.ASBypassLoad_s1e || (io.ASBypBmem_s1e && BIsLoad_s1w && !io.AKill_s1e),
193:            "ASBypassLoad_requires_load_tracking")
194:   fvAssert(!io.ATBypassLoad_s1e || (io.ATBypBmem_s1e && BIsLoad_s1w && !io.AKill_s1e),
195:            "ATBypassLoad_requires_load_tracking")
196: 
197:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
198:   // SAFETY 3: Data bypass implies the B-side instruction is NOT a load
199:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
200:   fvAssert(!io.ASBypassData_s1e || (!(io.ASBypBmem_s1e && BIsLoad_s1w) && !io.AKill_s1e),
201:            "ASBypassData_requires_no_load")
202:   fvAssert(!io.ATBypassData_s1e || (!(io.ATBypBmem_s1e && BIsLoad_s1w) && !io.AKill_s1e),
203:            "ATBypassData_requires_no_load")
204: 
205:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
206:   // SAFETY 4: Stall preserves pipeline register state
207:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
208:   // When Stall_s1 is high on Phi1, all pipeline registers should hold.
209:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, AValid_s2e.asUInt, "AValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled")
210:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, AValid_s1m.asUInt, "AValid_s1m_holds_when_stalled")
211:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, AValid_s2m.asUInt, "AValid_s2m_holds_when_stalled")
212:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, AValid_s1w.asUInt, "AValid_s1w_holds_when_stalled")
213: 
214:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, BValid_s2e.asUInt, "BValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled")
215:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, BValid_s1m.asUInt, "BValid_s1m_holds_when_stalled")
216:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, BValid_s2m.asUInt, "BValid_s2m_holds_when_stalled")
217: 
218:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, ABoosted_s2e.asUInt, "ABoosted_s2e_holds_when_stalled")
219:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, ABoostValid_s2e.asUInt, "ABoostValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled")
220: 
221:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, BBoosted_s2e.asUInt, "BBoosted_s2e_holds_when_stalled")
222:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, BBoostValid_s2e.asUInt, "BBoostValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled")
223: 
224:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, BIsLoad_s2e.asUInt, "BIsLoad_s2e_holds_when_stalled")
225:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, BIsLoad_s1m.asUInt, "BIsLoad_s1m_holds_when_stalled")
226:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, BIsLoad_s2m.asUInt, "BIsLoad_s2m_holds_when_stalled")
227:   assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, BIsLoad_s1w.asUInt, "BIsLoad_s1w_holds_when_stalled")
228: 
229:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
230:   // SAFETY 5: Kill/Except/NoDest clears the valid pipeline (A-side)
231:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
232:   // When AKill_s1e, ANoDest_s1e, or Except_s1w fires on an advancing cycle,
233:   // AValid_s2e must be false in that same cycle (the register update captures
234:   // the negation).
235:   fvAssert(!(io.Phi1 && !io.Stall_s1 && (io.AKill_s1e || io.ANoDest_s1e || io.Except_s1w))
236:            || !AValid_s2e,
237:            "AValid_s2e_cleared_by_kill_or_except")
238: 
239:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
240:   // SAFETY 6: Kill/Except/NoDest clears the valid pipeline (B-side)
241:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
242:   fvAssert(!(io.Phi1 && !io.Stall_s1 && (io.BKill_s1e || io.BNoDest_s1e || io.Except_s1w))
243:            || !BValid_s2e,
244:            "BValid_s2e_cleared_by_kill_or_except")
245: 
246:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
247:   // SAFETY 7: A-side pipeline propagation (s2e -> s1m on Phi2)
248:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
249:   // When Phi2 fires and AValid_s2e is true and not ignored, AValid_s1m
250:   // must be asserted in that cycle (the register update produces it).
251:   fvAssert(!(Phi2 && AValid_s2e && !io.AIgnore_s2e) || AValid_s1m,
252:            "A_valid_propagates_s2e_to_s1m")
253: 
254:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
255:   // SAFETY 8: B-side pipeline propagation (s2e -> s1m on Phi2)
256:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
257:   fvAssert(!(Phi2 && BValid_s2e && !io.BIgnore_s2e) || BValid_s1m,
258:            "B_valid_propagates_s2e_to_s1m")
259: 
260:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
261:   // SAFETY 9: A-side pipeline propagation (s1m -> s2m on Phi1 & not stalled)
262:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
263:   fvAssert(!(io.Phi1 && !io.Stall_s1 && AValid_s1m && !io.Except_s1w) || AValid_s2m,
264:            "A_valid_propagates_s1m_to_s2m")
265: 
266:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
267:   // SAFETY 10: A-side pipeline propagation (s2m -> s1w on Phi2)
268:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
269:   fvAssert(!(Phi2 && AValid_s2m) || AValid_s1w,
270:            "A_valid_propagates_s2m_to_s1w")
271: 
272:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
273:   // SAFETY 11: B-side pipeline propagation (s1m -> s2m on Phi1 & not stalled)
274:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
275:   fvAssert(!(io.Phi1 && !io.Stall_s1 && BValid_s1m && !io.Except_s1w) || BValid_s2m,
276:            "B_valid_propagates_s1m_to_s2m")
277: 
278:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
279:   // SAFETY 12: Alpha1/Beta1 imply their respective valid signals
280:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
281:   fvAssert(!io.Alpha1_s1m || AValid_s1m, "Alpha1_requires_AValid_s1m")
282:   fvAssert(!io.Beta1_s1m || BValid_s1m, "Beta1_requires_BValid_s1m")
283: 
284:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
285:   // SAFETY 13: BIsLoad pipeline consistency
286:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
287:   // BIsLoad_s2e should propagate to BIsLoad_s1m on Phi2
288:   fvAssert(!(Phi2 && BIsLoad_s2e) || BIsLoad_s1m,
289:            "BIsLoad_propagates_s2e_to_s1m")
290: 
291:   // BIsLoad_s1m should propagate to BIsLoad_s2m on Phi1 & not stalled
292:   fvAssert(!(io.Phi1 && !io.Stall_s1 && BIsLoad_s1m) || BIsLoad_s2m,
293:            "BIsLoad_propagates_s1m_to_s2m")
294: 
295:   // BIsLoad_s2m should propagate to BIsLoad_s1w on Phi2
296:   fvAssert(!(Phi2 && BIsLoad_s2m) || BIsLoad_s1w,
297:            "BIsLoad_propagates_s2m_to_s1w")
298: 
299:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
300:   // LIVENESS 14: A-side pipeline forward progress
301:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
302:   // When a valid instruction is in the s2e stage while the pipeline is
303:   // advancing (Phi1, not stalled), it must reach writeback within a bounded
304:   // number of cycles.  The pipeline depth s2e→s1m→s2m→s1w is ~3 cycles;
305:   // we allow 10 cycles margin for stalls and exceptions.
306:   // If AValid_s1w fires, the timer resets, indicating progress.
307:   assertLivenessTimer(
308:     AValid_s2e && !io.Stall_s1 && io.Phi1,
309:     AValid_s1w,
310:     10,
311:     "A_pipeline_forward_progress")
312: 
313:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
314:   // LIVENESS 15: B-side pipeline forward progress
315:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
316:   // B-side valid progresses from s2e → s1m → s2m.
317:   assertLivenessTimer(
318:     BValid_s2e && !io.Stall_s1 && io.Phi1,
319:     BValid_s2m,
320:     10,
321:     "B_pipeline_forward_progress")
322: 
323:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
324:   // LIVENESS 16: IStall/MemStall pipeline forward progress
325:   // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
326:   // The IStall condition should not persist indefinitely when the stall
327:   // source is no longer active.
328:   assertLivenessTimer(
329:     IStall_s2,
330:     !IStall_s2,
331:     10,
332:     "IStall_forward_progress")
333: }
334: 
335: object VerilogGenerator extends App {
336:   emitVerilog(new ABypassCtrl(), args)
337: }

# Counterexample Analysis Report: `ABypassCtrl.AValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled`

## 1. Verification Environment

- **Top Module**: `ABypassCtrl` (in `package llmverify`, `ABypassCtrl.scala`)
- **Design Under Test**: A simple bypass control unit with dual-issue pipeline registers (A-side and B-side)
- **Key Components**:
  - Pipeline registers: `AValid_s2e`, `AValid_s1m`, `AValid_s2m`, `AValid_s1w` (and B-side counterparts)
  - Boost logic registers: `ABoosted_s2e`, `ABoostValid_s2e`, etc.
  - Stall control: `Stall_s1`, `IStall_s1`, `MemStall_s1` inputs
- **Pipeline Update Rule**: 
  - On `io.Phi1` when NOT stalled (`~io.Stall_s1`): update s2e/s2m stage registers (line 119)
  - On `Phi2` (= `~io.Phi1`): update s1m/s1w stage registers (line 130)

## 2. Violated Assertion

- **Full Assertion Name**: `AValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled` (extracted from waveform filename)
- **Source Code Location**: `ABypassCtrl.scala`, **line 209**

```scala
// Lines 205-209:
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// SAFETY 4: Stall preserves pipeline register state
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// When Stall_s1 is high on Phi1, all pipeline registers should hold.
assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, AValid_s2e.asUInt, "AValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled")
```

- **Property Description**: When `io.Phi1` is high and `io.Stall_s1` is asserted (pipeline stalled), the pipeline register `AValid_s2e` should remain stable (hold its value).

## 3. Waveform Information

- **Waveform File**: `verilog/extra_bench/torch_regfile_ABypassCtrl/ABypassCtrl.AValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled.fst`
- **Time Range**: 0 ns to 20 ns (2 clock cycles)
- **Clock Period**: 10 ns (positive edge at times 0, 10)

### Key Signal Values

| Signal | Time 0 (Cycle 0) | Time 10 (Cycle 1) |
|---|---|---|
| `io.Phi1` | 1 | 1 |
| `io.Stall_s1` | **0** (NOT stalled) | **1** (STALLED) |
| `AValid_s2e` | **0** (initial) | **1** (updated) |
| `io.AValid_s1e` | 1 | 0 |
| `io.AKill_s1e` | 0 | 1 |
| `io.ANoDest_s1e` | 0 | 1 |
| `io.Except_s1w` | 0 | 1 |
| `_AValid_s2e_T` | 0 | 1 |
| `AValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled` | **1** (pass) | **0** (FAIL) |

### Failure Time Point

The assertion fails at **time 10 ns** (cycle 1). The assertion check signal transitions from 1 (pass) at time 0 to 0 (fail) at time 10.

## 4. Root Cause Analysis

### Root Cause Category: **Incorrect Assertion** (`assertion_error`)

The assertion is incorrectly written — it fires a false violation because it fails to account for legitimate pipeline register updates that occurred in the immediately preceding non-stalled cycle.

### Detailed Explanation

**Cycle 0 (time 0 ns): Not stalled**
- `io.Stall_s1 = 0`, `io.Phi1 = 1`
- The register update logic on line 119 fires:
  ```scala
  when(io.Phi1 & ~io.Stall_s1) {  // 1 & ~0 = 1 → enabled
      AValid_s2e := ~(io.AKill_s1e | io.ANoDest_s1e | io.Except_s1w)
  }
  ```
- Inputs: `io.AKill_s1e=0`, `io.ANoDest_s1e=0`, `io.Except_s1w=0`
- Computation: `~(0|0|0) = 1`
- **`AValid_s2e` is correctly updated from 0 (initial) to 1** at the beginning of cycle 1
- Assertion condition `io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1 = 1 && 0 = 0` → **not checked** (passes vacuously)

**Cycle 1 (time 10 ns): Stalled**
- `io.Stall_s1 = 1`, `io.Phi1 = 1`
- The register update logic on line 119 does NOT fire:
  ```scala
  when(io.Phi1 & ~io.Stall_s1) {  // 1 & ~1 = 0 → disabled
  ```
- **`AValid_s2e` correctly holds its value at 1** (no update occurs)
- Assertion condition `io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1 = 1 && 1 = 1` → **checked**
- `assertStableWhen` compares `AValid_s2e` at cycle 1 (value=1) vs cycle 0 (value=0)
- **1 ≠ 0 → FALSE VIOLATION triggered!**

### Why This is an Assertion Bug (Not a Design Bug)

The design is **correct**: 
- In cycle 0 (not stalled), the register was legitimately updated from 0 to 1 based on valid inputs
- In cycle 1 (stalled), the register correctly holds its value of 1

The `assertStableWhen` property operates with a single-cycle lookback semantics: whenever the condition is true, it checks that `signal[current_cycle] == signal[previous_cycle]`. This fails on the FIRST cycle where stalls become active, because the register's value changed in the previous non-stalled cycle.

The correct property should only check stability across **consecutive** stalled cycles, i.e., require that the stall condition was also true in the previous cycle. This can be expressed as:

```scala
// Fix: Add Past() qualifier to only check stability across consecutive stalled cycles
when(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1 && Past(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1)) {
    assert(Stable(AValid_s2e.asUInt))
}
```

Or equivalently, the `assertStableWhen` should incorporate a two-cycle lookback for the condition.

### Buggy Code Location

- **File**: `ABypassCtrl.scala`
- **Line**: 209
- **Code**: `assertStableWhen(io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1, AValid_s2e.asUInt, "AValid_s2e_holds_when_stalled")`
- **Issue**: The assertion condition `io.Phi1 && io.Stall_s1` does not include a `Past()` qualifier to exclude the first stalled cycle after a non-stalled cycle, causing a false violation when a pipeline register was legitimately updated in the preceding non-stalled cycle.

### Impact

The same erroneous pattern appears on lines 210-218 for all other `assertStableWhen` checks (for `AValid_s1m`, `AValid_s2m`, `AValid_s1w`, `BValid_s2e`, `BValid_s1m`, `BValid_s2m`, `ABoosted_s2e`, `ABoostValid_s2e`), meaning all of these assertions would also fire false violations under the same scenario.
